errors.sameAsOld: Your new password must be different from your current one.
errors.reauthenticate: For your security, sign out, sign back in, then change your password right away.
errors.weak: That password is too weak. Check the requirements.
errors.changeFailed: We couldn't change your password. Try again.

login.tagline: Share the ride with your campus community.
login.title: Log in
login.rememberOn: You'll stay logged in even if you close the app.
login.rememberOffWeb: You'll be logged out when you close this tab.
login.rememberOffApp: You'll be logged out when you close the app.
login.devSavedNoPassword: Enter the password for this account (it wasn't saved).

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: You haven't confirmed your email yet. Open the link we sent when you signed up.
errors.profileMissing: Your account exists but has no ConVía profile. Contact your institution's administrator.
errors.generic: We couldn't log you in. Check your connection and try again.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: It'll only take a minute.
register.verifySubtitle: One last step to ride with peace of mind.
register.readyText: Take a selfie to register your face. We use it to confirm it's you before each ride, so everyone rides safer. It's analyzed on your phone and never stored.
register.roleHint: With the same account you can be a passenger and a driver; switch modes anytime.
register.driverNext: After signup we'll verify your driver's license.
register.terms: I accept the Terms and Conditions and authorize the processing of my personal data, including biometric data, under ConVía's Privacy Policy.
register.termsHint: Open the Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy
register.readMore: Read more: terms and privacy policy
register.faceRequired: You need to register your face to request or post rides. You can do it now or later from your profile.

errors.name: Enter your first and last name.
errors.domain: That email isn't from a registered institution. Use your institutional email (e.g. @unisabana.edu.co).
errors.confirmationSent: We sent you a confirmation email. Open it on this phone, then log in.
errors.alreadyRegistered: An account already exists with this email. Log in with it.
errors.weakPassword: Your password doesn't meet the security requirements.
errors.generic: We couldn't create your account. Check your connection and try again.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to create a new password.
forgot.sentText: If {{email}} has a ConVía account, you'll get a link to create a new password. It expires in 1 hour.
forgot.sentHint: Open it on this device. If you don't see it in a few minutes, check your spam folder.

errors.rateLimited: We just sent you an email. Wait a minute before asking for another one.
errors.offline: Password recovery needs a server connection.
errors.generic: We couldn't send the email. Try again.

reset.title: Create a new password
reset.subtitle: Use it next time you log in to ConVía.
reset.expiredTitle: This link is no longer valid
reset.expiredText: Password links expire in 1 hour and work only once. Request a new one.

callback.failedTitle: We couldn't finish logging you in
callback.invalidLink: The confirmation link isn't valid or was already used.
callback.invalidOrUsed: The link isn't valid or was already used.
callback.noProfile: We couldn't find your profile after confirming your email.
callback.noProfileMicrosoft: We couldn't find your profile after logging in with Microsoft.
callback.microsoftFailed: We couldn't log you in with Microsoft. Try again.
callback.retryMicrosoft: Try again with your institutional account.
callback.retryLogin: Log in to continue; if your account was already confirmed, you'll get right in.

screen.title: Is this your car?
screen.intro: Record 3 seconds of the car arriving. We check with AI that the plate, make, and color match your ride. The video is deleted as soon as verification ends.
screen.cameraNeeded: We need the camera to record the car.
screen.cameraBlocked: Camera is blocked for ConVía. Turn it on in your phone settings.
screen.webUnavailable: Video verification is available in the app for Android and iPhone.
screen.mock: Test mode: simulated result, no real AI.

verified.title: This is your ride
verified.text: The plate, make, and color match {{driver}}'s car.

mismatch.title: Don't get in
mismatch.text: This car doesn't match your ride.
mismatch.plate_mismatch: We read plate {{read}}, but your ride is {{expected}}.
mismatch.brand_mismatch: The plate matches, but this car is a {{read}} and your ride is a {{expected}}. It could be a copied plate.
mismatch.color_mismatch: The plate matches, but this car is {{read}} and your ride is {{expected}}. It could be a copied plate.
mismatch.reported: Thanks. We reported this car for review.
mismatch.reportFailed: Couldn't send the report. Try again.
mismatch.cancelMessage: You'll free up your seat and the driver will be notified.

tips.front: Aim at the front or back of the car, where the plate is.
tips.near: Record when the car is a few meters away and almost stopped.
tips.still: Keep your phone steady for the 3 seconds.

clip_unreadable.title: We couldn't open the video
clip_unreadable.text: Record again with the ConVía camera.

no_car.title: We didn't see a car
no_car.text: Point at the arriving car and record all of it.

no_plate.title: We didn't see the plate
no_plate.text: Record the front or back of the car.

not_live_photo.title: Record the car directly
not_live_photo.text: It looks like a screen or a printed photo.

poor_quality.title: The video looks blurry or dark
poor_quality.text: Record again holding your phone steady.

plate_unreadable.title: We couldn't read the plate
plate_unreadable.text: Get a little closer and show the whole plate, with no glare.

low_confidence.title: We're not sure about the plate
low_confidence.text: Record again with the plate closer and well lit.

plate_uncertain.title: We didn't read the plate clearly
plate_uncertain.text: Record again closer to the plate before you decide.

vehicle_uncertain.title: We couldn't confirm the car
vehicle_uncertain.text: The plate matches, but we're not sure about the make or color. Compare them yourself or record again in good light.

rate_limited.title: Too many verifications right now
rate_limited.text: Wait a few seconds and try again.

service_unavailable.title: Service unavailable
service_unavailable.text: Try again in a few minutes. Meanwhile, compare the plate yourself.

too_many_attempts.title: Too many attempts
too_many_attempts.text: Compare the plate yourself or message the driver.

server_error.title: Something went wrong on our end

upload_failed.title: Couldn't upload the video
upload_failed.text: Check your connection and try again.

network_error.title: Couldn't connect to verification
network_error.text: Check your connection and try again.

not_found.title: We couldn't find your trip
not_found.text: Go back to your requests and try again.

not_accepted.title: Your trip isn't active
not_accepted.text: Verification is available when your request is accepted and the trip hasn't ended.

unsupported_vehicle.title: Not available for this vehicle
unsupported_vehicle.text: AI verification works only with car plates (3 letters and 3 numbers).
